subject: Third-party security assessment: evidence request & scheduling
messages:
From: Alice Gomez <alice.gomez@assessaudit.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: vendor-ops <sow@assessaudit.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Third-party security assessment: evidence request & scheduling

Hi Mina,

Thanks for confirming Redwood as the target for our upcoming third-party security assessment. To keep the schedule on track we propose the following:

- Kickoff window: June 16-18 (testing ramp: 6/17)
- Evidence delivery: interim findings by EOD June 17; final report and remediation POAM by June 25
- Scope: web app (prod and staging), API gateway, Kubernetes clusters (cluster-a, cluster-b), and basic social engineering reconnaissance (email spoofing tests).

Access requirements (please provide by EOD today if possible):
- Read-only service account for AWS with arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/assessaudit-readonly
- Temporary SSH bastion account for 6/17-6/18 with sudo disabled
- Short-lived kubeconfig (role based) covering cluster-a
- Allowlist IPs: 35.200.10.0/24, 34.120.5.8/32

Attached: access-instructions.pdf (VPN + bastion setup), evidence-checklist.csv

Two clarifications requested:
1) Any documented maintenance windows we should avoid? (we assume none during 6/17)
2) Any specific components excluded from the test? (e.g., payment processing sandbox)

If the schedule works we’ll run smoke tests on 6/16 evening and full tests 6/17.

Thanks,

Alice Gomez
Engagement Lead
Assessaudit, Inc.
alice.gomez@assessaudit.com
+1 (415) 555-0192
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>

Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Third-party security assessment: evidence request & scheduling

Alice — thanks. That plan is fine with a couple constraints and asks:

- IP allowlist: we can open the narrower /32 and the /24 you requested but need the exact source IPs for scheduled scans; can you confirm block-by-block before we open?
- Kube access: we will provide a read-only kubeconfig scoped to 'inspection' role. Marcus — can you provision the temp accounts and kubeconfigs today?
- Exclusions: the payment processor (payments.redwood.com) and customer PII store are out of scope.

We also need the draft report to omit exact exploit PoCs in any externally-shared artifacts; a redacted version can include reproduction steps at a high level only.

Attached: mina-evidence-matrix.xlsx (mapping of controls to artifacts we can provide)

We’ll aim to have the temp accounts ready by tomorrow morning (6/16). If anything changes, flag here.

—Mina
Mina Haddad
Senior Security Manager
